opening.argument: The clearest evidence is the guest’s account of being drawn into a Bitcoin-doubling scheme and his description of reviewing scam sites. He recounts sending Bitcoin after a promise to double it in 72 hours, then sending more after receiving a return; he also says he reviewed scam sites. These are accounts of his own experience, not directions for viewers to send money. The video is presented as a conversation about a crypto trader’s journey, and the guest explicitly warns people not to be fooled. Taken together, the interview discusses a career and its lessons, including exposure to scams, rather than promoting an investment destination.
